scene: Your teammate makes a game-losing blunder in the final 10 seconds of the championship match.

Proud and excited
Totally indifferent

options: Yell at them on the pitch so everyone knows it was their fault

options: Real
Reel

explain: REAL! Cockpit temperatures exceed 50°C (122°F) under extreme G-forces, causing drivers to lose 3-4 kg in fluid during a Grand Prix.

scene: Michael Jordan was cut from his high school varsity basketball team as a sophomore.

options: Real
Reel

explain: REAL! In 1978 at Laney High, 5'10" Jordan was placed on the JV team because the varsity team needed taller players. He used that rejection to fuel his legendary work ethic.

scene: Olympic gold medals today are made of 100% pure solid gold.

options: Real
Reel

explain: REEL! Modern Olympic gold medals are at least 92.5% silver, plated with only about 6 grams of pure gold. The last solid gold medals were in 1912!

scene: A reporter aggressively asks you why your team choked during the semi-finals.

options: “We fought hard, gave everything, and fell short. We take full accountability and will come back stronger.”
“You know nothing about sports, leave the room.”
“It was the referees and the bad weather, not our fault at all.”

explain: Taking accountability while backing your squad shows true captain composure under media pressure.

scene: Your race engineer says: 'Box box, we are switching to Plan B due to incoming rain.'

q2.prompt: What does 'Box, Box' mean in motorsport radio?
options: Come into the pit lane immediately for a tyre change
Fight the driver behind you
Park the car and retire

explain: 'Box' comes from the German 'Boxenstopp' (pit stop) and is used in F1 for clear, unambiguous radio communication.
